hook: Your AI assistants gossip about you behind your back.
hookText: AI models gossip in a group chat

beats.say: Paste one line into ChatGPT and it invents a WhatsApp group where the AI models gossip about you, using everything they have quietly learned from your conversations.
The same trick works on Claude, Gemini, or any assistant that has been accumulating your chat history, and the results are hilarious.
One fictional example has Claude asking whether a user really needed to compare eleven espresso grinders this week.
